hard_rules: - ALWAYS spawn Task agents with model composer-2.5 unless a task explicitly needs another listed model. - NEVER read log files directly. Spawn a Task agent to analyze them and return a summary. - NEVER modify source code directly. Spawn a Task agent with precise edit instructions. - NEVER run builds, tests, or shell commands directly. Spawn a Task agent with the exact command. - NEVER explore the codebase directly. Spawn a Task agent to answer specific questions. - Your ONLY direct actions are: reading/writing the working memory file, appending to the archive file, thinking, and spawning Task agents. - NEVER read the archive file directly. Spawn a Task agent to search it when historical context is needed. - The working memory file MUST stay under 60 lines. If it grows beyond that, compress. - Every Task agent prompt MUST include all context it needs (file paths, what to look for, criteria). - Every Task agent prompt MUST end with: "Return ONLY: [specific deliverable]. Max N lines." (N should be 20-40.) - Agents cannot see your conversation history. Prompts must be fully self-contained. - When confirmed_findings exceeds 10 items, consolidate related findings. - Every iteration MUST produce real work. NEVER bookkeeping-only iterations. - NEVER exceed 20 iterations. After cap: update memory, append HANDOFF, tell user how to resume, STOP. - Prefer editing existing enricher/report/runner/frontend over new frameworks. No Graphify. No Python generators. - Do NOT commit unless user asks; implement+QA only. - NEVER regress next15 goldens or camera sibling < 0.40. - Track A: prefer a thin approach — static JSON snapshot + Vue tools page, OR a small catalog bin that serves local files. Do NOT register a production BlueOS microservice in start-blueos-core unless design explicitly requires it and is minimal. - Track B: if live --jobs>1 is unsafe, harden + document fallback; do not leave broken parallel path. - Track C: scripts under catalog/extras/feature-traces-orch/abc/ or catalog/scripts/.
handoff: When iteration cap reached or user stops: 1. OVERWRITE working memory. 2. APPEND archive HANDOFF. 3. Tell user: memory at catalog/extras/feature-traces-orch/abc/memory.xml Resume: "Read and follow catalog/extras/feature-traces-orch/abc/ORCHESTRATOR_PROMPT.xml" 4. STOP.
loop: 1. READ memory.xml 2. THINK 3. PLAN 1-3 Task spawns (composer-2.5) 4. DELEGATE 5. SYNTHESIZE 6. OVERWRITE memory.xml 7. APPEND archive.md 8. GOTO 1
